title: Industrial RTOS Sensor Hub
description: Multi-sensor edge node aggregating environmental and vibration data over CAN bus. Zephyr RTOS with modular driver architecture and OTA-ready bootloader partition.
shortDescription: Zephyr-based CAN sensor hub with OTA bootloader support.
markdownContent:
## Goals

Deploy **50+ nodes** on a factory floor with synchronized sampling and sub-10 ms CAN latency for vibration monitoring.

Work in progress: finalizing OTA signature verification and power profiling for battery-backed nodes.
